bricks.name: Shipyard app
bricks.description: The Tauri shell, a Rust process on the person's computer. Every HTTP call goes through shipyard-http: no redirects, a size cap, proxy from ALL_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY and NO_PROXY, and an optional extra CA.

bricks.name: Shipyard web view
bricks.description: The React UI in the Tauri web view. Its content security policy allows connections to itself and to IPC only, and one frame origin.

bricks.name: OS keychain
bricks.description: macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager or Secret Service. The only place for a secret.

bricks.name: Issue tracker
bricks.description: Jira Cloud or Data Center, GitHub Issues, GitLab Issues, Azure DevOps or Linear, as the connection says.

bricks.name: Code host
bricks.description: GitHub, GitLab or Azure DevOps, on the host of the connection.

bricks.name: Model provider
bricks.description: An OpenAI-style HTTP endpoint: LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM, OpenRouter or a vendor API.

bricks.name: MCP server (HTTP)
bricks.description: An MCP server of a connection that is reached over HTTP.

bricks.name: Agent CLI
bricks.description: Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI or OpenCode, started by Shipyard as a child process.

bricks.name: Release page
bricks.description: The GitHub API answer for the latest release of the Shipyard repository.

bricks.name: draw.io embed
bricks.description: embed.diagrams.net, the draw.io editor in a frame.

bricks.name: npm registry
bricks.description: registry.npmjs.org, reached by npx for the OpenSpec check.

bricks.name: Figma API
bricks.description: api.figma.com, read with a token that sits in the keychain.

bricks.name: OpenRouter
bricks.description: openrouter.ai. OAuth PKCE sign-in that returns an API key, then the model provider endpoint.

bricks.name: Microsoft login
bricks.description: Deferred (Q-132): no code calls it yet. login.microsoftonline.com. Entra ID device code sign-in for Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry.

bricks.name: Local runtime
bricks.description: Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM or LiteLLM on localhost. Found by a probe, with no sign-in.
